card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The space just before a dose amount, such as after 'starting dosage is' or 'from', in dosing instructions. Also fires on a few digits or letters inside drug names or amounts.

modes.label: Space before dose
modes.description: A blank token right before the number in a recommended-dose statement.
modes.example: The recommended starting dosage of ICLUSIG is<< >>45 mg orally once daily.

modes.label: Inside drug names or numbers
modes.description: A piece of a brand name or the first digit of a dose in a dosing passage.
modes.example: Avoid coadministration of SCEMB<<L>>IX at 200 mg twice

modes.label: Other stray spots
modes.description: Occasional linking or instruction words in other text.
